queries: Jewish man attacked cafe San Francisco 2026
rounds.what_returned: Results immediately surfaced an incident matching the video (Augustine restaurant, blue patio umbrellas, Santana Row) — but located in San Jose, not San Francisco. Two Israeli-American victims, three suspects. No 'Islamist' framing in any mainstream coverage.
rounds.lesson: The incident is real but the tweet has at least two factual errors: city (San Jose vs San Francisco) and attacker characterization (Islamists). Multiple mainstream sources (ABC7, NBC, CBS, KTVU, JTA) confirmed San Jose.

what_helped: Searching for the underlying incident (Jewish attack + San Francisco + 2026) immediately surfaced the real story despite the city being wrong in the tweet
The Augustine restaurant name visible in the video provided a distinctive cross-check signal
Searching suspect names + ethnicity/religion directly confirmed the 'Islamist' claim was false
Checking whether hate crime charges were filed was a strong signal on the ideological framing claim
what_hurt: The tweet's wrong city (San Francisco vs San Jose) could have led a one-shot model to discard results or try harder for non-existent SF coverage
The 'Islamist' framing is not directly contradicted in one place — it requires combining: (a) no source uses that label, (b) suspects have Christian/Assyrian-Armenian background
insights.would_multipass_help: yes — a one-shot model might stop after finding the incident (confirming an attack occurred) without then checking the 'Islamist' label. A second pass specifically targeting suspect identity/religion is needed to catch the most important falsehood in the tweet.
insights.deepseek_advice: For tweets with strong ideological labels ('Islamists,' 'white supremacist,' 'antifa'), always run a second query explicitly targeting the suspect's identity/religion — the first search confirms the event happened, the second checks whether the characterization matches. Also watch for city/location errors: bay area tweets often conflate San Francisco with nearby cities like San Jose or Oakland.
